sentences.en: I'm Jenna Fisher.
sentences.zh: 我是珍娜·费舍。

sentences.en: And I'm Angela Kinsey.
sentences.zh: 我是安吉拉·金西。

sentences.en: We were on The Office together, and we're best friends.
sentences.zh: 我们一起演过《办公室》，而且我们是最好的朋友。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the ultimate Office Lovers podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在我们要为你带来终极的《办公室》爱好者播客。

sentences.zh: 每周，我们将通过独家采访深入探索《办公室》的世界，

sentences.en: Hey, lady.
sentences.zh: 嘿，女士。

sentences.en: We're not in the studio together.
sentences.zh: 我们现在没有一起在录音室里。

sentences.zh: 我们在进行远程录音。

sentences.en: Lord, we're doing this wild thing in technology where you zoom, and your face pops up in a
sentences.zh: 天哪，我们正在用这种疯狂的技术，通过Zoom连线，你的脸会出现在

sentences.en: little box.
sentences.zh: 小方框里。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么事？

sentences.zh: 我对此太兴奋了，真不敢相信我没有立刻跟你分享。

sentences.en: Lady, we were in the San Francisco airport a while back.
sentences.zh: 女士，前阵子我们在旧金山机场。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And there's a freaking old tech hole, like, museum.
sentences.zh: 那里居然有一个该死的老式科技，呃，博物馆似的东西。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm sure it's just an exhibit.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我确信那只是个展览。

sentences.en: It was all old telephones, lady.
sentences.zh: 里面全都是老式电话，女士。

sentences.en: It was called Give Me a Ring, a Telephone Retrospective.
sentences.zh: 它叫“给我打个电话：电话回顾展”。

sentences.en: I mean, I almost was, like, late for the flight.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我差点就赶不上航班了。

sentences.en: Josh was like, where'd you go?
sentences.zh: 乔什问：你去哪儿了？

sentences.en: I thought you were just going to the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 我以为你只是去趟洗手间。

sentences.en: I'm like, there's a telephone retrospective.
sentences.zh: 我说：这里有个电话回顾展。

sentences.en: Look, I can put these in stories.
sentences.zh: 看，我可以把这些发到动态里。

sentences.en: Can you see this?
sentences.zh: 你能看到这个吗？

sentences.en: That's crazy.
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了。

sentences.en: I mean, I had so many of those telephones in my own house, in my own lifetime.
sentences.zh: 我是说，在我有生之年，我自己家里就有好几个那种电话。

sentences.en: You know, hats off to the SFO airport.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，向旧金山国际机场致敬。

sentences.en: I always love it when an airport gives me something to do while I'm waiting.
sentences.zh: 我总是很喜欢机场能在我等待的时候给我找点事做。

sentences.en: Yeah, me too.
sentences.zh: 对，我也是。

sentences.en: I appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: Me too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: You know, in the St. Louis airport, in the American terminal, they have this whole play space for kids.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在圣路易斯机场的美国航空航站楼，他们有一个专门给孩子们玩的游乐区。

sentences.en: Oh, those are great.
sentences.zh: 哦，那些太棒了。

sentences.en: And my dad helped build it.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸帮忙建造的。

sentences.en: No!
sentences.zh: 不会吧！

sentences.en: Yes, because it's courtesy of the Magic House in St. Louis, which is a children's museum.
sentences.zh: 真的，因为那是圣路易斯魔术屋赞助的，那是一个儿童博物馆。

sentences.en: And he used to work there and help build exhibits.
sentences.zh: 他以前在那里工作，帮忙建造展览。

sentences.en: And so he also built this exhibit that they gifted to the airport.
sentences.zh: 所以他也建造了这个他们赠送给机场的展览。

sentences.en: And there's a little tower, and you can pretend like you're like an air traffic controller.
sentences.zh: 那里有一个小塔楼，你可以假装自己是空中交通管制员。

sentences.en: And there's a little, you know, baggage thingy.
sentences.zh: 还有一个小小的，你知道的，行李传送带那样的东西。

sentences.en: And you can get on a plane.
sentences.zh: 你还可以登上飞机。

sentences.en: Yeah, and it's all like a play space.
sentences.zh: 对，全都是那种游乐空间。

sentences.en: And when I walked by it, I was like, God, I love that.
sentences.zh: 当我从旁边走过时，我想，天哪，我太喜欢这个了。

sentences.en: And how cool is it that every time you walk past it, you can think of your dad?
sentences.zh: 每次你走过它时，都能想起你的爸爸，这多酷啊？

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I took a picture of it.
sentences.zh: 我拍了张照片。

sentences.en: I'll give it to you for stories.
sentences.zh: 我发给你，你可以放到动态里。

sentences.en: Old telephones and an airport play space in stories.
sentences.zh: 故事里出现了老式电话和机场儿童游乐区。

sentences.en: Lady, I'm here for it.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我太期待了。

sentences.zh: 好了，我们要不要告诉大家今天在做什么？

sentences.en: Because if you are a super fan of The Office, we think you're going to really like today's episode.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你是《办公室》的超级粉丝，我们觉得你会非常喜欢今天的节目。

sentences.en: Oh, my goodness.
sentences.zh: 哦，我的天哪。

sentences.en: You are going to love it.
sentences.zh: 你们一定会爱上它的。

sentences.zh: 它的灵感来源于粉丝关于我们片场生活的提问，特别是关于我们的房车。

sentences.en: So we're going to dig into some behind the scenes of our day-to-day on The Office.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要深入了解一下我们在《办公室》日常生活的幕后故事。

sentences.en: And it made me so happy.
sentences.zh: 这让我太开心了。

sentences.en: I went back in time on this one, lady.
sentences.zh: 老天，这一期让我感觉时光倒流了。

sentences.en: I have a folder on my laptop called Our Trailers.
sentences.zh: 我的笔记本电脑里有一个文件夹叫“我们的房车”。

sentences.en: Did you know that?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 知道。

sentences.en: Because when we were putting together pictures for our book,
sentences.zh: 因为当我们为书整理照片时，

sentences.en: we have a whole chapter in our book that kind of gives you the behind the scenes of the hair and makeup trailer
sentences.zh: 我们的书里有一整章差不多展示了发型和化妆房车的幕后故事，

sentences.en: and sort of life off the set.
sentences.zh: 还有片场之外的生活。

sentences.en: But I think we're going to dig in even deeper on today's episode.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得我们在今天的节目中会挖掘得更深。

sentences.en: We are.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I think one of the things I was so tickled by is that I have a folder of all the stuff for our book.
sentences.zh: 我觉得最让我高兴的一点是，我有一个文件夹，里面装着我们书的所有素材。

sentences.en: It's called The Office BFFs.
sentences.zh: 它叫《办公室好闺蜜》。

sentences.en: But somehow, this one for the trailer just made its way out.
sentences.zh: 但不知怎么的，这个关于房车的文件夹自己跑出来了。

sentences.en: And it's just been hanging on my desktop for years.
sentences.zh: 它在我的桌面上挂了好多年。

sentences.en: And I've never tidied it.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有整理过它。

sentences.en: I've never put it back where it belongs.
sentences.zh: 我从来没把它放回该去的地方。

sentences.en: You know why?
sentences.zh: 你知道为什么吗？

sentences.en: Because it wanted to inspire this episode today.
sentences.zh: 因为它想要启发今天的这期节目。

sentences.en: It's been waiting.
sentences.zh: 它一直在等待。

sentences.en: I guess so.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: Well, let's kick things off with a chit-chat sent in from Harrison in Boston.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们从来自波士顿的哈里森发来的闲聊开始吧。

sentences.en: Hi, Office Ladies.
sentences.zh: 嗨，《办公室女士们》。

sentences.en: My name is Harrison from Boston, Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 我叫哈里森，来自马萨诸塞州波士顿。

sentences.en: I love the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢这个播客。

sentences.en: Thank you guys so much for everything that you do.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们所做的一切。

sentences.en: My chit-chat question is about teachers.
sentences.zh: 我的闲聊问题是关于老师的。

sentences.en: You both have talked about teachers before in the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 你们俩以前在播客里谈论过老师。

sentences.en: And Jenna, I know that your sister is a teacher.
sentences.zh: 珍娜，我知道你姐姐是一位老师。

sentences.en: Could you guys share or talk about a teacher that you had who changed your life
sentences.zh: 你们能分享或谈谈对你们的生活有过改变的老师吗？

sentences.en: or who made a lifelong impact on you?
sentences.zh: 或者对你们产生过终生影响的老师？

sentences.en: You know, for me, it was my English teacher, Mrs. Roney, who fostered such a love of reading
sentences.zh: 你知道，对我来说，是我的英语老师罗尼太太，她培养了我对阅读和写作的热爱，

sentences.en: and writing and whose lessons still come back to me all these years later.
sentences.zh: 多年后的今天，她的教诲依然时常浮现在我的脑海中。

sentences.en: So I was hoping that you guys could share about teachers that you have had in your lives that
sentences.zh: 所以我希望你们能分享一下在你们的生活中，

sentences.en: really, you know, left an impact on you or changed you for the better.
sentences.zh: 真正对你们产生影响或者让你们变得更好的老师。

sentences.en: I think teachers are so overlooked and so important.
sentences.zh: 我觉得老师常常被忽视，但他们太重要了。

sentences.en: And I'd love to hear about the ones that really made you who you are.
sentences.zh: 我很想听听那些真正塑造了你们的老师的故事。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thanks for your question, Harrison.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你的提问，哈里森。

sentences.en: I love this question.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢这个问题。

sentences.en: Yes, my sister is currently a teacher and my mom was a teacher.
sentences.zh: 是的，我姐姐目前是一名老师，我妈妈以前也是一名老师。

sentences.en: She's retired.
sentences.zh: 她退休了。

sentences.en: Yeah, Harrison.
sentences.zh: 对，哈里森。

sentences.en: I mean, my sister Janet is a teacher.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我姐姐珍妮特是一名老师。

sentences.en: Oh my gosh.
sentences.zh: 哦天哪。

sentences.en: I'm going to get the number wrong, but she's been teaching pre-K for like 27 years.
sentences.zh: 我数字可能会记错，但她教学前班大概有27年了。

sentences.en: And she listens to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 而且她也听这个播客。

sentences.en: So if I got that wrong, she's going to let me know about it.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我记错了，她肯定会告诉我。

sentences.en: But we love our teachers so much.
sentences.zh: 但我们太爱我们的老师了。

sentences.en: And you're so right.
sentences.zh: 你说的太对了。

sentences.en: They forever shape your life.
sentences.zh: 他们会永远塑造你的人生。

sentences.en: Having that one teacher, and we all have that one, you know, that literally made you see
sentences.zh: 只要有那么一位老师——我们所有人都有这样一位老师，你知道的——他真的能让你

sentences.en: the world in a different way or made you feel safe or made you feel seen.
sentences.zh: 以不同的视角看世界，或者让你感到安全，或者让你觉得自己被看见。

sentences.en: And I knew right away, two teachers popped into my mind immediately.
sentences.zh: 我立刻就知道了，我的脑海里马上浮现出了两位老师。

sentences.en: Jenna, what about you?
sentences.zh: 珍娜，你呢？

sentences.en: Same.
sentences.zh: 一样。

sentences.en: I have a teacher from high school and a teacher from college.
sentences.zh: 我有一位高中老师和一位大学老师。

sentences.en: Okay, you go firSt.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你先说。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, I'll start in high school.
sentences.zh: 那我就从高中说起吧。

sentences.en: My teacher, Mrs. Marge Mineas.
sentences.zh: 我的老师是玛吉·米内斯太太。

sentences.en: What a name.
sentences.zh: 真是个好名字。

sentences.en: Yeah, Mrs. Mineas.
sentences.zh: 对，米内斯太太。

sentences.en: She taught religion at my high school.
sentences.zh: 她在我的高中教宗教课。

sentences.en: I went to a Catholic girls high school in St. Louis, Missouri called Narex Hall.
sentences.zh: 我曾在密苏里州圣路易斯的一所名叫内雷克斯大厅的天主教女子高中读书。

sentences.en: And during my time there, I did really grapple with my feelings about the Catholic faith.
sentences.zh: 在那段日子里，我对天主教信仰的感情确实有过一番挣扎。

sentences.en: I was really troubled by certain aspects of the institution, you know?
sentences.zh: 这个机构的某些方面真的很让我困扰，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And I don't need to get into it here, but she was my religion teacher.
sentences.zh: 我不需要在这里细说，但她是我的宗教老师。

sentences.en: And when I went to her, the way that she just took me so seriously and took my thoughts and
sentences.zh: 当我去找她时，她对待我是那么认真，对待我的想法和

sentences.en: concerns so seriously, she really counseled me.
sentences.zh: 担忧也是那么认真，她真的给了我很多指导。

sentences.en: She spent a lot of time asking me questions.
sentences.zh: 她花了很多时间问我问题。

sentences.en: And then when I had to write papers in class, she let me wrestle with these topics.
sentences.zh: 然后，当我必须在课上写论文时，她让我深入探讨这些主题。

sentences.en: And I got A's.
sentences.zh: 我还得了A。

sentences.en: She gave me A's.
sentences.zh: 她给了我A。

sentences.en: And she didn't need me to just spit back what I was being taught.
sentences.zh: 她不需要我只是生搬硬套地复述我学到的东西。

sentences.en: Do you know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Like, I didn't have to be fake.
sentences.zh: 就像，我不需要虚伪。

sentences.en: I didn't have to pretend.
sentences.zh: 我不需要假装。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: She encouraged you to have your critical thinking and to really be able to explore all of your
sentences.zh: 她鼓励你进行批判性思考，并真正去探索你对这个主题的所有

sentences.en: feelings on the subject.
sentences.zh: 感受。

sentences.en: It didn't matter what it aligned with or not.
sentences.zh: 无论它是否符合某种标准都无所谓。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And the thing that I really credit her with is that I think, especially at that time in
sentences.zh: 我最感谢她的一点是，我觉得，特别是在我当时的

sentences.en: my life, it was a critical point.
sentences.zh: 人生阶段，那是一个关键的节点。

sentences.en: And to have someone take me so seriously, it meant that I didn't abandon faith completely.
sentences.zh: 能有人如此认真地对待我，这意味着我没有完全放弃信仰。

sentences.en: You know, I am not a practicing Catholic today, and I still have my connection to God and to
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我今天虽然不是一个虔诚的天主教徒，但我仍然和上帝以及

sentences.en: prayer.
sentences.zh: 祈祷保持着联系。

sentences.en: And I really credit her with that because she helped me find a way to keep that peace alive
sentences.zh: 我真的很感激她，因为她帮我找到了一种方法，让内心的平静得以

sentences.en: in me.
sentences.zh: 延续。

sentences.en: I didn't have to throw everything out the door just because I didn't believe in the
sentences.zh: 我并没有因为我不相信某些东西就把一切都全盘否定

sentences.en: particular religion that I was being asked to practice.
sentences.zh: 我被要求去信奉的那种特定的宗教。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That is very powerful.
sentences.zh: 这真的很有力量。

sentences.en: That is a real gift.
sentences.zh: 这真是一个天赋。

sentences.en: And she was like that with all of us.
sentences.zh: 而且她对我们所有人都这样。

sentences.en: She really cared.
sentences.zh: 她是真的很关心。

sentences.en: She didn't treat us like, you know, silly teenagers.
sentences.zh: 她没有把我们当成那种，你知道的，傻里傻气的青少年。

sentences.en: She treated us like fully formed, interesting people.
sentences.zh: 她把我们当成思想成熟、有趣的人。

sentences.en: So I love her for that.
sentences.zh: 所以我为此非常爱戴她。

sentences.en: What about you, Ange?
sentences.zh: 你呢，安吉？

sentences.en: Well, the first teacher that came to mind for me was my theater teacher in elementary
sentences.zh: 嗯，我脑海中浮现的第一位老师是我小学时的

sentences.en: school.
sentences.zh: 戏剧老师。

sentences.en: So this was at Jakarta International School.
sentences.zh: 当时是在雅加达国际学校。

sentences.en: And I had this teacher named Dr. Allen.
sentences.zh: 我有一位名叫艾伦博士的老师。

sentences.en: He was an amazing theater director.
sentences.zh: 他是一位了不起的戏剧导演。

sentences.en: And we would do these fantastic musicals and plays.
sentences.zh: 我们会排演那些精彩的音乐剧和话剧。

sentences.en: But in his class, it was the first time anyone ever taught me improv.
sentences.zh: 但在他的课上，那是第一次有人教我即兴表演。

sentences.en: And I was in maybe like fourth grade and he taught us some just very like short form improv games.
sentences.zh: 当时我大概在上四年级，他教了我们一些非常简短的即兴游戏。

sentences.en: And it was like every single part of my body came alive.
sentences.zh: 感觉我全身的每个细胞都活了过来。

sentences.en: I was like, what is this?
sentences.zh: 我当时想，这是什么？

sentences.en: This is the cooleSt.
sentences.zh: 这太酷了。

sentences.en: I love it so much.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢了。

sentences.en: I want to do this forever.
sentences.zh: 我想一辈子都做这个。

sentences.en: It was just like electric, you know, because I had seen plays and done school plays and there
sentences.zh: 那种感觉简直就像触电一样，你知道的，因为我以前看过话剧，也演过学校的话剧，

sentences.en: was a script and you stuck to the script.
sentences.zh: 有剧本，而且你得照着剧本演。

sentences.en: But this idea of yes anding and free association and having to really listen and form a scene
sentences.zh: 但这种“肯定并顺应”（yes and）的理念、自由联想，以及必须真正倾听并与其他人搭档创作一个场景，

sentences.en: with someone else in a partnership was life-changing for me.
sentences.zh: 对我的生活产生了改变。

sentences.en: And he also took us seriously and was invested and didn't think we were goofballs, but really
sentences.zh: 而且他也对我们很认真，投入了心血，不觉得我们是在胡闹，而是真心

sentences.en: wanted us to find our own comedic voice.
sentences.zh: 希望我们能找到属于自己的喜剧之声。

sentences.en: when he acts, his acting laugh.
sentences.zh: 他演戏时的笑声。

sentences.en: And it's so damn funny.
sentences.zh: 而且太该死的好笑了。

sentences.en: I would find myself laughing or trying not to laugh because my character could never really
sentences.zh: 我会发现自己笑出来，或者极力克制不笑，因为我的角色永远不能真正

sentences.en: bust out laughing.
sentences.zh: 放声大笑。

sentences.en: But there were so many times when Steve pretending to laugh cheered me up.
sentences.zh: 但有太多次，史蒂夫假装大笑让我开心了起来。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，对。

sentences.en: I mean, I think overall, it was such a beneficial place to work.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我觉得总体而言，这是一个非常棒的工作场所。

sentences.en: To go into a place where your job was being around comedy and making comedy, it did affect my mood.
sentences.zh: 去一个以喜剧和创作喜剧为工作的地方，这确实影响了我的心情。

sentences.en: And I remember I would think, gosh, I often leave work in a happier mood than when I got there
sentences.zh: 我记得我曾想过，天哪，我下班时的心情往往比上班时还要好，

sentences.en: just by virtue of having laughed all day.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为整天都在欢笑。

sentences.en: And I thought, what's it like to play a character on a drama where you're dealing with like intense
sentences.zh: 我想，在正剧里扮演一个整天都要面对紧张题材、

sentences.en: subject matter all day or you have to cry all day or you have to have like an intense scene?
sentences.zh: 或者整天都要哭泣、或者必须演紧张戏份的角色，会是什么感觉？

sentences.en: Because that gets into the fiber of you, you know?
sentences.zh: 因为那些东西会融入你的骨髓，你知道吗？

sentences.en: It's like it's pretend, but you are accessing things in order to bring it forward.
sentences.zh: 这就像是假装的，但为了呈现出来，你必须调动内心的感受。

sentences.en: Or exposing yourself to things if it's like subject matter that's really troubling.
sentences.zh: 或者让自己接触那些真正令人烦恼的题材。

sentences.en: Yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 没错，没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: It's funny.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: When we did our rewatch, you know that episode where Pam and Jim, they go to buy stuff to cheer
sentences.zh: 当我们重温剧集时，你知道那一集吗？帕姆和吉姆去买东西来让凯文开心，

sentences.en: up Kevin.
sentences.zh: 那是迈克尔的生日。

sentences.en: It's Michael's birthday.
sentences.zh: 但所有人都很担心凯文。

sentences.en: But everyone's worried about Kevin.
sentences.zh: 所有人都很担心凯文。

sentences.en: Everyone's worried about Kevin.
sentences.zh: 然后帕姆有个小桥段，她模仿说，卢克，我是你父亲。

sentences.en: And Pam has her little thing where she's like, Luke, I am your father.
sentences.zh: 她演了整段。

sentences.en: She does the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 她演了整段。

sentences.en: So that day that we filmed in that store, I won't share why, but I was pretty down that day.
sentences.zh: 所以那天我们在那家店里拍戏时，原因我就不分享了，但我那天情绪挺低落的。

sentences.en: I wasn't in a good mood.
sentences.zh: 我心情不太好。

sentences.en: And I remembered worrying that you might see it in my performance.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时还担心你可能会从我的表演中看出这一点。

sentences.en: And when we did the rewatch, I thought, no, I think if I didn't know, I would know.
sentences.zh: 而当我们重温那一集时，我想，不，我觉得如果我不知道内情，我大概也看不出来。

sentences.en: But for whatever reason, that was a tough one that day to go in.
sentences.zh: 但不管怎样，那天去上班确实挺不容易的。

sentences.en: Because I had to be funny.
sentences.zh: 因为我必须表现得搞笑。

sentences.en: Like, I had to be peppy and up and flirty and funny.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我必须表现得有活力、积极、调皮又好笑。

sentences.en: And I was not feeling it.
sentences.zh: 而我当时根本没有那种状态。

sentences.en: But I think I covered.
sentences.zh: 不过我想我掩饰过去了。

sentences.en: I think you did.
sentences.zh: 我想你确实做到了。

sentences.en: I think you did fantastic.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你表现得棒极了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I think the hardest thing for me, Layla, was the reverse, which is playing a grump around
sentences.zh: 莱拉，对我来说最难的事情其实恰恰相反，就是在那么多搞笑的人周围扮演一个脾气暴躁的人。

sentences.en: a lot of really funny people.
sentences.zh: 因为我也想笑。

sentences.en: Because I wanted to laugh.
sentences.zh: 而且我确实在笑。

sentences.en: And I was laughing.
sentences.zh: 我一直在努力克制不让自己笑出来。

sentences.en: And I was trying to suppress laughter all the time.
sentences.zh: 而且，詹娜，你知道的，说到这样一份工作：有时你带着许多心事去上班，

sentences.en: And, you know, I will say, Jenna, talk about a job where sometimes you come to work and
sentences.zh: 但一天工作结束时，你却带着更快乐的心情离开。

sentences.en: you've just got a lot going on, but then you leave at the end of your workday happier.
sentences.zh: 我和你还有我们的播客也是这样。

sentences.en: And that is true for me with you and our podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 哦，确实。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 很多时候我们录制结束，特别是我们在录音室的时候，一录完，

sentences.en: So many times when we're done recording, especially when we're in studio, the minute we're done,
sentences.zh: 我们就一起走到停车场。

sentences.en: we walk to our cars together.
sentences.zh: 一路上我们都在聊天。

sentences.en: We talk the whole entire way.
sentences.zh: 我们会在其中一辆车旁站着聊个不停。

sentences.en: We have a whole chat session, like standing next to one of our cars.
sentences.zh: 然后我们上车开车回家，

sentences.en: And then we get in our cars and we drive home and we either leave each other a message
sentences.zh: 在开回家的路上，要么给对方留语音，

sentences.en: or call each other on the drive home.
sentences.zh: 要么给对方打电话。

sentences.en: I mean, it's just like being back on the set.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这感觉就像回到了片场一样。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: So I love it.
sentences.zh: 所以我很喜欢。

sentences.en: I love doing this podcast with you, lady.
sentences.zh: 我也很喜欢跟你一起做这个播客，老姐。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Me too.
sentences.zh: 我也是。

sentences.en: Aw.
sentences.zh: 噢。

sentences.en: Well, you guys, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位，非常感谢。

sentences.en: This was a fun trip down memory lane for us.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，这是一次充满回忆的趣味之旅。

sentences.en: We have lots of great behind-the-scenes pictures that I'll put in stories of our time on the set.
sentences.zh: 我们有很多精彩的幕后照片，我会把它们发到我们片场时光的快拍里。

sentences.en: Emily, thank you for that suggestion.
sentences.zh: 艾米丽，谢谢你的建议。

sentences.en: And we'll see you guys next week.
sentences.zh: 我们下周见，各位。

sentences.en: We hope you had a great one.
sentences.zh: 希望你们过得愉快。

sentences.en: Thanks for writing in.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你们来信。

sentences.en: We appreciate you all so much.
sentences.zh: 我们非常感谢大家。

sentences.en: See you next week.
sentences.zh: 下周见。
